schedule.external_local_scheduler: Not verified or changed by this website update

scope: Long-only swing research: days to weeks
Liquid U.S.-listed stocks and unleveraged ETFs
portfolio_check: Retrieve Robinhood accounts and holdings afresh through Finances at every check; read the current watchlist when available. Verify coverage and source timestamps before comparing overlap, concentration and closed positions. A balance is not confirmed investable cash.
research_method: Build a sourced case, then challenge it with contrary evidence and independently check material facts and calculations. Use timestamped market data and primary company, SEC or fund documents. Compare candidates with cash and a diversified alternative.
reasoning_mode: A maximum-thinking or Ultra setting cannot be selected or verified through the scheduled-task controls. Two-pass validation is a research instruction, not a model-setting claim.
alert_policy: Publish only materially supported new candidates or material thesis/risk changes. Suppress repeats and expired setups. Three checks do not require three alerts. Report persistent material access issues separately; an incomplete check is not a no-opportunity result.
execution: Research only. All trading decisions and execution remain manual. No orders, simulated orders, cash transfers or autonomous execution.
risk_limits: No options, margin, leverage, shorts, leveraged/inverse funds, microcaps or illiquid securities. No personalized dollar allocations or share quantities without confirmed liquidity needs, horizon and tolerable loss.
privacy: This feed contains public research and non-sensitive verification status only. No account identifiers, balances, share counts, trade history, deposits, credentials or private financial plans. The existing portfolio publication is a separate dated record.
